regional_reset_ports.why: HBM-UCIE8 10-20 (method of the S81 SerDes column lp6): the die delivers one clock per region (ck_tx / ck_rx = two regional roots of the core PLL stream clock, ck_rck = the far die's forwarded pma_rck) and that region's reset beside it (released on the same edge by its landed die reset distribution), landed 2 stages on the region clock (synchroniser on the forwarded clock). No reset root, no cross-region reset path.

note: HBM-UCIE9 10-21 (structural successor of the ucie2 gate FAIL): three regions, 0 landings. tx (core PLL clk: tx face reg, live flag, PMA TX), rx (core PLL clk: rate-matcher read side, SRAM read port, status, rx/st out regs) and rck (forwarded pma_rck: PMA RX, its output register u_prr, rate-matcher write side, SRAM write port). tx and rx share no net (no landing needed); the only rck -> rx crossings are the CDC children u_rm (gray-FIFO rate matcher, elastic IDLE deletion, SRAM u_rmm dual clock) and u_sts (2-flop status sync). Bench loops the flat parent's own pma_tx back into pma_rx. Was (HBM-UCIE8 10-20): 2 regions core/rck.
